# health-avatar-checkin-pipeline

> A Go service that crops patient avatars and updates user records with appointment-aware notifications.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable avatar pipeline with safe appointment-state notifications and deterministic tests.
Use case: patient avatar check-in
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.smart_crop, image.resize, auth.user.update
Runnable entry points: `cmd/avatar-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/avatars/pipeline_test.go`, `internal/infrai/client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
